snippet.title: Springtale - Gamejam Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi everyone! This video showcases the little game that I did in the unreal gamejam. Download, and play it for FREE with Link Below!

Unreal Spring Jam was a 5-day gamejam hosted by Epic Games at Itch.io
All the assets in the game were created from scratch within this five day!

DOWNLOAD LINK
https://ffuhro.itch.io/springtale

GAMEJAM SUBMISSION PAGE
https://itch.io/jam/2020-unreal-spring-jam/rate/667213

Follow me on my Twitch Channel!!
https://www.twitch.tv/ffuhro

Follow me on Twitter @ffuhro for more Game dev related Stuff!

Don't forget to subscribe for more Unreal related stuff!
